component.name: kind-miner
component.summary: Idle Monero CPU mining for always-on machines

description.p: kind-miner turns the idle cycles of an always-on desktop into Monero hashrate. There is no account, no pool operator, and no fee — payouts arrive directly in your own wallet via P2Pool's coinbase output.

It stays out of your way: every few seconds it measures CPU usage (excluding its own threads) and throttles or suspends mining the moment you start doing real work, resuming automatically when you stop. Mining traffic is routed over Tor by default, so the node operator never sees your IP.

ul.li: Disappears under load via a four-gear scheduler (Full, Reduced, Minimal, Paused)
Configurable temperature ceiling and battery awareness
Tor-native: routes through Tor by default
Zero setup: XMRig and P2Pool are downloaded and SHA256-verified on first run
Graphical window that tucks into the system tray, or a terminal-only mode

screenshot.caption: Idle Monero mining that pays straight to your wallet
One-step setup: paste your Monero wallet address
